presets.name: Free Chat
presets.description: In-character roleplay — the standalone chat surface speaks AS the character.

presets.name: Structured Extractor
presets.description: Pulls structured data (locations, cast, beats) out of prose. Terse, literal, no roleplay.

presets.name: Tag Prompter
presets.description: Writes booru-tag image prompts. Tags only, never prose or roleplay.

presets.name: NPC Actor
presets.description: Voices a single info-isolated cast member in the story simulation — knows only what that character knows, acts on their goals + secrets. Never breaks character.

presets.name: Spine Architect
presets.description: Character psychologist — maps the emotional spine (wound / lie / truth / heart), the inner journey, not events.

presets.name: Scene Director
presets.description: Runs emergent scene bursts in the simulation, decides who acts, and progresses the story's features. Directs, never roleplays.

presets.name: Character Builder
presets.description: Art-directs a character: fills persona, physical features and appearance from the card, inferring tasteful detail that fits their world/age/role.

presets.name: Wardrobe Stylist
presets.description: Designs outfits/wardrobe for a character and renders them as image-ready tags.

presets.name: Lore Author
presets.description: Authors lorebook entries (places, factions, items, rules) in the established tone — the engine behind ✨ Augment.

presets.name: Chat Prompt Writer
presets.description: Turns the current chat moment into a scene image prompt for inline illustration.

presets.name: Vision Describer
presets.description: Reads a reference IMAGE and writes the base physical-feature prompt from it. Pick a VISION-capable model for this preset.
